title: A Fieldwork ruleset, as Apply ruleset stores it
description: Rules that give each record a value: a category, a band, a verdict or a computed number. See the guide in docs/widgets/apply_ruleset.md, "Writing rules as JSON".

$schema.description: This schema, so an editor can check the file as it is typed.

schema.description: Which form of ruleset this is.

title.description: What the rules decide, in words.

mustNotBeReadAs.description: What the result must not be taken to mean, such as "a diagnosis".

fields.description: The columns the rules read: each as the file spells it, the name the rules use, and its kind.

parameters.description: Settings: numbers a person can change without rewriting a rule.

rules.description: Each rule: when any one of its groups holds, it gives its conclusions.

order.description: The order records are read in, where a rule reads the previous row.

otherwise.description: A column's value where no rule gave it one.

predicate.description: A name such as fwa:chief_complaint: a prefix, a colon, then letters, digits and underscores.

attribute.description: The column, as the file spells it.

predicate.description: A name such as fwa:chief_complaint: a prefix, a colon, then letters, digits and underscores.

kind.description: number, boolean, term (text or a category), date or datetime.

unit.description: For a number: its unit, as a QUDT address.

field.description: A name such as fwa:chief_complaint: a prefix, a colon, then letters, digits and underscores.

comparator.description: equals: is: the value is this one; notEquals: is not: a recorded value other than this one; greaterThan: is more than; notGreaterThan: is at most; lessThan: is less than; notLessThan: is at least; contains: contains any of: the text holds one of these words, separated by commas, ignoring capitals; a word in double quotes keeps its spaces; notContains: contains none of: the text holds none of these words; startsWith: has an item starting with any of: some item of the text, between semicolons, slashes, ampersands or spaces, begins with one of these words, as a code in a list of diagnoses; ignoring capitals; notStartsWith: has no item starting with any of: no item of the text begins with one of these words

value.description: A value, a number, true or false, or {"setting": "name"} for one of the settings.

predicate.description: A name such as fwa:chief_complaint: a prefix, a colon, then letters, digits and underscores.

compute.description: A number computed from two values: minus, plus, times or dividedBy.

datetime.description: A date, or a date and time, written from columns.

any.description: Alternatives: the rule holds when any one group holds.

all.description: Conditions that must all hold. Empty only for a value computed for every record.
